# GrowthPilot

> Zero-dependency autonomous CLI, MCP server, Agent Skill, and GitHub Action that audits any local codebase or live website URL across 18 deterministic SEO, GEO/AI Search (`llms.txt`), Schema.org JSON-LD, and CRO copywriting rules and generates ready-to-deploy marketing assets.

## Core Documentation

- [Official Website & Interactive Studio](https://codesphere-u.github.io/growthpilot/): Flagship product website featuring the in-browser CRO AI-slop analyzer, live `llms.txt` / Schema.org builder, and 18-rule rubric explorer.
- [README & Overview](https://github.com/codesphere-u/growthpilot/blob/main/README.md): Executive overview, comparison matrix, live URL proof (`funagigs.com`), quickstarts, CLI flags, and MCP reference.
- [Getting Started Guide](https://github.com/codesphere-u/growthpilot/blob/main/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md): Persona workflows for founders, marketers, and developers, plus framework deployment guides.
- [MCP & AI Agents Guide](https://github.com/codesphere-u/growthpilot/blob/main/docs/MCP_AND_AGENTS.md): Setup for Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, Codex, GitHub Actions SARIF gating, and Docker.
- [Architecture & Rubric](https://github.com/codesphere-u/growthpilot/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Pipeline architecture, 100-point rubric breakdown (`MKT001`–`MKT018`), SSR vs. JS bundle scanner, and SSRF guardrails.

## Agent Skill & Playbooks

- [GrowthPilot Skill (`SKILL.md`)](https://github.com/codesphere-u/growthpilot/blob/main/skills/growthpilot/SKILL.md): Agent skill instructions (`npx skills add codesphere-u/growthpilot`) covering local repos, live URLs, copy analysis, and MCP mode.
- [SEO & GEO Playbook](https://github.com/codesphere-u/growthpilot/blob/main/skills/growthpilot/references/seo-and-geo-playbook.md): Complete 18-rule grading rubric and `llmstxt.org` specification checklist.
- [CRO & Zero-Slop Copywriting](https://github.com/codesphere-u/growthpilot/blob/main/skills/growthpilot/references/cro-and-copywriting.md): Above-the-fold conversion formulas and banned AI cliché detection rules.
- [Zero-to-One Launch Playbook](https://github.com/codesphere-u/growthpilot/blob/main/skills/growthpilot/references/zero-to-one-launch.md): Archetype-specific launch tactics and programmatic SEO blueprint.
- [MCP & CI Setup](https://github.com/codesphere-u/growthpilot/blob/main/skills/growthpilot/references/mcp-and-ci-setup.md): Tool schemas for all 6 MCP tools and GitHub Action inputs/outputs.

## Releases & Governance

- [Changelog](https://github.com/codesphere-u/growthpilot/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Version history (`v1.0.0` through `v1.4.4`).
- [Contributing](https://github.com/codesphere-u/growthpilot/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Contributor checklist, static checks (`ruff`, `mypy`, `pytest`, `billshock`), and rule authoring standards.
- [Security Policy](https://github.com/codesphere-u/growthpilot/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Responsible disclosure, SSRF protections, broad-root guardrails, and zero-dependency guarantees.
